problem:

$$
{\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{\sqrt{x}}f(x,y)\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}x+{\int }_{1}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{\sqrt{2-x}}f(x,y)\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}x
$$

∫01∫0xf(x,y)dydx+∫12∫02−xf(x,y)dydx

a
∫0y2∫2−y21f(x,y)dxdy
b
∫y21∫02−y2f(x,y)dxdy
c
∫01∫y22−y2f(x,y)dxdy
